description: Verified current-affairs notes for 16 October 2026, covering banking, welfare, governance, science, defence, agriculture, digital language access and a Tamil Nadu export milestone, followed by exam-oriented MCQs.

stories.title: RBI sanctions Emirates NBD India branch amalgamation with RBL Bank
stories.summary: The Reserve Bank of India sanctioned the amalgamation of Emirates NBD Bank P.J.S.C.'s Indian branches with RBL Bank Limited. The scheme will take effect on 1 December 2026, after which the Emirates NBD branches in India will operate as RBL Bank branches.
key_facts: RBI issued the sanction on 16 October 2026.
The sanction was granted under Section 44A(4) of the Banking Regulation Act, 1949.
The amalgamation becomes effective on 1 December 2026.
All Indian branches of Emirates NBD Bank P.J.S.C. will function as branches of RBL Bank from the effective date.
stories.exam_link: Static GK: The Reserve Bank of India regulates banks under the Banking Regulation Act, 1949; Section 44A deals with voluntary amalgamation of banking companies.
stories.source_title: RBI sanctions Scheme of Amalgamation of Emirates NBD Bank P.J.S.C. in India with RBL Bank Limited

stories.title: PM-AJAY update highlights village development and educational support
stories.summary: The Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment reported progress under the Pradhan Mantri Anusuchit Jaati Abhyuday Yojana. Its Adarsh Gram component has covered more than 47,200 villages and benefited over 47.79 lakh people, while the scheme also supports livelihood projects and hostels for Scheduled Caste students.
key_facts: PM-AJAY is a centrally funded scheme focused on the socio-economic development of Scheduled Castes.
Its three broad components are Adarsh Gram, Grants-in-Aid for district or state projects, and construction or repair of hostels.
More than 47,200 villages have been covered under the Adarsh Gram component.
The reported beneficiary count under that component exceeds 47.79 lakh people.
stories.exam_link: Static GK: Article 46 of the Constitution directs the State to promote the educational and economic interests of Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes and other weaker sections.
stories.source_title: PM-AJAY strengthens villages, livelihoods and educational infrastructure for Scheduled Castes

stories.title: Revised assistance guidelines issued for National Sports Federations
stories.summary: The Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports issued revised financial-assistance guidelines for National Sports Federations for 2026-27 to 2030-31. The framework has an outlay of ₹7,386.74 crore and strengthens requirements for transparent athlete and coach selection while expanding support for international events and regional sports cooperation.
key_facts: The guidelines cover the 2026-27 to 2030-31 period, aligned with the Sixteenth Finance Commission cycle.
The approved outlay is ₹7,386.74 crore.
Federations are required to publish athlete and coach selection policies in advance.
The framework provides assistance for hosting international events and for sports activities involving groupings such as BRICS and BIMSTEC.
stories.exam_link: Static GK: Sports is listed in the State List, but the Union supports national federations, international participation and national sports policy through executive programmes.
stories.source_title: Government issues revised guidelines for financial assistance to National Sports Federations

stories.title: TDB extends ₹150 crore RDI support for quantum-secure networks
stories.summary: The Technology Development Board under the Department of Science and Technology signed an agreement with Bengaluru-based QNu Labs for ₹150 crore of support from the Research, Development and Innovation Fund. The ₹300 crore project aims to advance an indigenous quantum-secure and sensing network portfolio from mid-stage prototypes to deployment-ready technology.
key_facts: TDB support is ₹150 crore through optionally convertible debt under the RDI Fund.
The total project cost is ₹300 crore.
The project seeks to move technologies from Technology Readiness Levels 4-5 to TRL-9.
The proposed India Quantum Secure and Sensing Networks backbone covers identity security, location integrity, network security and time integrity.
stories.exam_link: Static GK: The Technology Development Board is a statutory body created under the Technology Development Board Act, 1995 to promote commercial application of indigenous technology.
stories.source_title: TDB-DST supports QNu Labs with ₹150 crore under RDI Fund for quantum secure and sensing networks

stories.title: First Kanda Express for Agartala carries buffer onions
stories.summary: The Department of Consumer Affairs dispatched the first Kanda Express for Agartala with about 440 metric tonnes of buffer onions. The consignment was expected to arrive on 18 October 2026 and was planned to serve seven of Tripura's eight districts as part of price-stabilisation operations.
key_facts: The Agartala-bound rail consignment carries approximately 440 metric tonnes of onions.
Its arrival was scheduled for 18 October 2026; the arrival was therefore a planned event at the time of the release.
Distribution was planned across seven of Tripura's eight districts.
Government onion-buffer operations are supported through the Price Stabilization Fund.
stories.exam_link: Static GK: The Price Stabilization Fund supports market interventions in selected agricultural commodities to moderate price volatility and protect consumers and producers.
stories.source_title: First-ever Kanda Express to Agartala to strengthen onion availability in the North-East

stories.title: Indian Navy commissions indigenous multi-purpose vessel INS Samarthak
stories.summary: The Indian Navy commissioned INS Samarthak at Karwar, Karnataka. Described as the Navy's first indigenous Multi-Purpose Vessel, it will support trials of next-generation weapons and sensors along with surveillance, patrol, unmanned-system and humanitarian-assistance roles.
key_facts: INS Samarthak was commissioned at Karwar in Karnataka.
It is the Indian Navy's first indigenous Multi-Purpose Vessel.
The vessel has more than 75% indigenous content.

Its roles include technology trials, maritime surveillance and reconnaissance, offshore patrol, target launch and recovery, unmanned-system operations, and humanitarian assistance and disaster relief.
stories.exam_link: Static GK: Karwar on the Karnataka coast hosts INS Kadamba, a major Indian Navy base developed under Project Seabird.
stories.source_title: Indian Navy commissions INS Samarthak, its first indigenous Multi-Purpose Vessel

stories.title: Erode organic palmyra jaggery begins maiden export to Bulgaria
stories.summary: APEDA facilitated the first export of 1.755 metric tonnes of certified organic palmyra jaggery powder from Gobichettipalayam in Tamil Nadu's Erode district to Varna, Bulgaria. The consignment, flagged off on 15 October, was routed by sea through Chennai Port.
key_facts: The export quantity was 1.755 metric tonnes.
The product was certified under India's National Programme for Organic Production and for the European Union market.
The supply base covers 137 acres under organic cultivation.
The shipment originated in Gobichettipalayam, Erode district, and was destined for Varna in Bulgaria via Chennai Port.
The release reported a 15-22% better price realisation for farmers and about 17% more for the manufacturer than in the domestic market.
stories.exam_link: Static GK: The Agricultural and Processed Food Products Export Development Authority functions under the Union Ministry of Commerce and Industry.
stories.source_title: APEDA facilitates maiden export of organic palmyra jaggery powder from Tamil Nadu to Bulgaria

stories.title: National Conference on e-Governance Reforms opens in Dharamshala
stories.summary: A two-day National Conference on e-Governance Reforms began in Dharamshala on 16 October. The programme brought together Union, state and Union Territory representatives and experts to discuss digital transformation, emerging technologies and citizen-centric governance.
key_facts: The conference was scheduled for 16-17 October 2026 in Dharamshala, Himachal Pradesh.
The first day's themes included digital transformation, emerging technologies and citizen-centric governance.
Sessions planned for 17 October included cybersecurity, replication of good practices, data analytics and state, district and grassroots initiatives.
The event is a forum for sharing administrative reforms and scalable e-governance practices across levels of government.
stories.exam_link: Static GK: The Department of Administrative Reforms and Public Grievances is the Union government's nodal department for administrative reforms and public-grievance redress policy.
stories.source_title: Two-day National Conference on e-Governance Reforms begins in Dharamshala

stories.title: Ayush invention report records 4,077 patent applications since 2014-15
stories.summary: The Controller General of Patents, Designs and Trade Marks released a status report on Ayush-related inventions in India for 2014-2026. It recorded 4,077 patent applications and 711 grants from 2014-15 to 2025-26, indicating substantially increased intellectual-property activity in the sector.
key_facts: The report covers the financial years 2014-15 to 2025-26.
It recorded 4,077 Ayush-related patent applications and 711 patents granted.
The report was released during the 11th Ayurveda Day observance.
Maharashtra led the state-wise tally with 744 filings and 142 grants.
stories.exam_link: Static GK: The Office of the Controller General of Patents, Designs and Trade Marks functions under the Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade.
stories.source_title: Status Report on Ayush Related Inventions in India records sharp rise in patent activity

stories.title: BHASHINI and IISc develop speech synthesis models for Sourashtra
stories.summary: The Digital India BHASHINI Division and the Indian Institute of Science developed text-to-speech models for Sourashtra, a minority Indo-Aryan language spoken predominantly by the Sourashtra community in Tamil Nadu. The work is intended to support digital applications, accessibility, language learning and documentation.
key_facts: The models were developed by the Digital India BHASHINI Division under the Digital India Corporation in collaboration with IISc Bengaluru.
Sourashtra is an Indo-Aryan language spoken predominantly by the Sourashtra community in Tamil Nadu.
Text-to-speech technology converts written text into synthesised spoken output.
The announced models are intended for uses such as digital services, education, accessibility and language preservation.
stories.exam_link: Static GK: BHASHINI is the National Language Translation Mission under the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology, aimed at expanding digital access in Indian languages.
stories.source_title: BHASHINI and IISc develop text-to-speech models for Sourashtra language

stories.title: PAIMANA infrastructure dashboard receives quarterly data update
stories.summary: The Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation released a quarterly update to PAIMANA, its infrastructure-sector performance dashboard. Launched on 16 April 2026, the platform consolidates official indicators to support transparent monitoring, evidence-based policy and public access to infrastructure statistics.
key_facts: PAIMANA was launched on 16 April 2026.
The 16 October release was a quarterly data update rather than the launch of a new dashboard.
The platform brings selected infrastructure performance indicators into one official dashboard.
Its stated purposes include evidence-based policy, sector monitoring and easier public access to official statistics.
stories.exam_link: Static GK: The Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation oversees official statistics and monitors major central-sector infrastructure projects in India.
stories.source_title: MoSPI releases quarterly update of PAIMANA infrastructure dashboard

mcqs.question: The RBI sanctioned the Emirates NBD-RBL Bank amalgamation under which provision of the Banking Regulation Act, 1949?
mcqs.explanation: Section 44A concerns voluntary amalgamation of banking companies, and RBI issued the sanction under subsection (4).

mcqs.question: On which date is the sanctioned amalgamation of Emirates NBD's Indian branches with RBL Bank scheduled to take effect?
mcqs.explanation: The RBI notification states that the scheme will become effective on 1 December 2026.

mcqs.question: Which PM-AJAY component focuses on integrated development of Scheduled Caste-majority villages?
mcqs.explanation: Adarsh Gram is the village-development component of PM-AJAY; the other options belong to unrelated government programmes.

mcqs.question: The revised financial-assistance guidelines for National Sports Federations cover which period?
mcqs.explanation: The guidelines run from 2026-27 through 2030-31 and align with the Sixteenth Finance Commission cycle.

mcqs.question: What is the total project cost of the QNu Labs quantum-secure network project supported by TDB?
mcqs.explanation: TDB support is ₹150 crore, while the full project cost stated in the release is ₹300 crore.

mcqs.question: The QNu Labs project aims to advance its technology portfolio to which Technology Readiness Level?
mcqs.explanation: The project intends to move technologies from TRL 4-5 prototypes to TRL-9, indicating deployment-ready maturity.

mcqs.question: The first Kanda Express sent to Agartala carried which commodity?
mcqs.explanation: The train carried approximately 440 metric tonnes of buffer onions for planned distribution in Tripura.

mcqs.question: INS Samarthak, commissioned at Karwar, is best described as which type of vessel?
mcqs.explanation: INS Samarthak is the Indian Navy's first indigenous Multi-Purpose Vessel, designed for trials and varied operational-support roles.

mcqs.question: The maiden certified organic palmyra jaggery export from Erode was destined for which city?
mcqs.explanation: The shipment from Gobichettipalayam was sent through Chennai Port to Varna in Bulgaria.

mcqs.question: Which body facilitated the maiden export of organic palmyra jaggery powder from Tamil Nadu?
mcqs.explanation: APEDA, under the Ministry of Commerce and Industry, facilitated the certified organic agricultural export.

mcqs.question: Which subject was specifically scheduled for discussion on the second day of the National Conference on e-Governance Reforms?
mcqs.explanation: The 17 October programme included cybersecurity, good-practice replication, data analytics and grassroots initiatives.

mcqs.question: How many Ayush-related patent applications were recorded for 2014-15 to 2025-26 in the released status report?
mcqs.explanation: The report recorded 4,077 applications and 711 granted patents over the stated period.

mcqs.question: Sourashtra, for which BHASHINI and IISc developed text-to-speech models, belongs to which language family?
mcqs.explanation: Sourashtra is an Indo-Aryan language, though its largest present-day speaker community is concentrated in Tamil Nadu.

mcqs.question: What does a text-to-speech system primarily do?
options: Converts written text into spoken audio
mcqs.explanation: Text-to-speech technology synthesises audible speech from written input, improving access and language-enabled digital services.

mcqs.question: PAIMANA is primarily a dashboard for monitoring which broad area?
mcqs.explanation: PAIMANA consolidates official infrastructure performance indicators to aid monitoring, policy analysis and public access to statistics.
